system.description:
Before making a Focused attack you activate this Skill and gain one of the following effects.

  • Bastard Strike: Your next Focused attack deals additional damage equal to your [Soul], as long as the activating Focused attack is made this turn.
  • Bash and Break: If you are holding an item in your free hand or have an Arm Equipment, you can use it to surprise and batter an enemy. Make a Quick Attack that deals no damage, on a hit the enemy becomes Staggered.
